rationale:
Issue #960 reports dartfmt 1.3.7 silently dropping the nullable '?' on a function-typed initializing formal ('C({@m int this.v()?})' formatted to 'C({@m int this.v()})', with the formatter's own self-check reporting unexpected output). The minimized production patch is exactly one line in lib/src/source_visitor.dart, adding 'token(node.question);' after 'visit(node.parameters);' in the formal-parameter visit that emits node.period/identifier/parameters, so the previously unemitted question token is now written. That is the direct cause of the dropped token and nothing else: the version bump in lib/src/cli/formatter_options.dart, CHANGELOG, pubspec.yaml/pubspec.lock churn present in the original commit are all excluded from patches/minimized-production.patch. Triggers are the unchanged upstream fixtures from the same fixing commit (test/regression/0900/0960.unit reproduces the issue snippet verbatim; test/whitespace/functions.unit adds nullable old-style function-typed parameter cases including 'function(int? this.callback()?)'), executed through the pre-existing test/formatter_test.dart harness with no new production API introduced by the fix. Strict evidence for both original and post-minimization runs passes every gate: build on both revisions, buggy differential with reproduced selectors ['test/formatter_test.dart::regression 0960.unit', 'test/formatter_test.dart::whitespace functions.unit'], deterministic fingerprints across 3 repetitions (38 matrix runs), fixed isolated/suite/reversed clean, and fixed full suite all green with buggy full-suite failures confined to the declared triggers. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and dart-lang/dart_style#960 is the allowed verified issue key.

Issue #960 (labeled bug, closed by PR #962) reports dartfmt 1.3.7 silently dropping the '?' when formatting a function-typed initializing formal ('C({@m int this.v()?});' formatted to 'C({@m int this.v()});'), which the formatter itself flags as unexpected output. The minimized production patch is a single line in SourceVisitor's function-typed formal parameter handling, adding 'token(node.question);' after 'visit(node.parameters);' so the existing nullability token is emitted; this is exactly the omission described in the issue. The minimization correctly strips everything unrelated that appeared in the original commit: the dartStyleVersion constant bump in lib/src/cli/formatter_options.dart, CHANGELOG.md, pubspec.yaml, and pubspec.lock dependency-version churn. No refactor, formatting, feature extension, docs, or config remains in the minimized patch. The triggers are the project-native .unit fixtures from the same fixing commit (test/regression/0900/0960.unit reproducing the issue snippet verbatim, and two added cases in test/whitespace/functions.unit for nullable old-style named and initializing-formal function-typed parameters), executed via the pre-existing test/formatter_test.dart harness; they exercise only the public formatter entry point and introduce no production API added by the fix. Strict evidence for both original and post-minimization runs shows build passing on both revisions, both declared selectors reproducing on the buggy revision with buggy full-suite failures confined to those triggers, all fixed isolated/suite/reversed runs green, 38 matrix runs at 3 repetitions, and deterministic fingerprints (4 groups). active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so #960 is not a duplicate, and it matches the single allowed verified issue key.

risks: The whitespace/functions.unit fixture adds a named non-initializing function-typed parameter case ('function({int? callback()?})') alongside the initializing-formal case; the selector granularity is file-level, so per-case attribution to the single-line fix is inferred from the fixed-revision green run rather than observed independently.
